about: [O2] The hijack of a parked car, good hands (brief O2 §3, §5): walk to the parked saloon ahead of the start's car (&park=saloon), E at its door, the 2 s at the glass (the lock), in, drive off 60 m. Twice in a row (the second at the next parked car, &park=saloon,coupe). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o2_park_good.json

steps.check: D.inMs != null && D.inMs < 2600 && D.kind === 'saloon' && D.drove > 40 && D.stats.broke === 1 && D.prompt === 'E  break in'
steps.label: good: the saloon broken into in 2 s and driven off

steps.check: D.inMs != null && D.inMs < 2600 && D.kind === 'coupe' && D.drove > 40 && D.stats.broke === 2
steps.label: good, again: the coupe
